paper_title: Constraints on hidden photons produced in nuclear reactors
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter epsilon (dimensionless); plot shows Log10(epsilon), values emitted as epsilon
notes: Paper derives a revised 95% CL upper limit on hidden-photon kinetic mixing epsilon vs mass mX from published TEXONO reactor neutrino data, correcting Park (2017) by including photon-hidden-photon oscillations in reactor/detector media. No numerical table is given; the limit appears only in Fig. 1. Data points here are reconstructed from the text: for mX >~ 20 eV the limit is ~4^(1/4)~1.4x weaker than Park's epsilon ~ 1e-5 (flat up to the kinematic range ~MeV); for mX < mgamma ~ 20 eV the sensitivity degrades as (mgamma/mX)^2 in epsilon (signal ~ epsilon^4 mX^8), losing all sensitivity below ~0.1 eV. Values are approximate reconstructions, not digitized figure data. Not a dark-matter search (reactor production), so no local DM density assumed.
